cover: Diplomatic pushes, military shakeups, and political resignations reshape global affairs
cover_scene: A split view of global capitals under dramatic skies, featuring diplomatic conference tables, military headquarters, and government domes.

slides.scene: US, Russian, and Ukrainian flags displayed around a formal negotiation table in a grand hall, illuminated by soft amber lighting.
slides.headline: US Envoys Plan Peace Talks After Abu Dhabi Summit
slides.body: US special envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff will meet separately with Vladimir Putin and Volodymyr Zelenskyy following talks in Abu Dhabi. Negotiation teams agreed on a large-scale prisoner exchange despite lacking a major peace breakthrough.

slides.scene: A military convoy escorting a dark sedan into a heavily fortified base at dusk, with naval vessels visible in a nearby strait.
slides.headline: US Treasury Secretary Relocates Over Iranian Threats
slides.body: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent moved to a secure military base following intelligence regarding Iranian threats against his life. The security measure follows similar relocations by top administration officials amid ongoing tensions with Tehran.

slides.scene: An empty wooden vice-presidential chair inside a grand legislative chamber beside an Indonesian flag, lit by a soft spotlight.
slides.headline: Indonesian Vice President Resigns Over Campaign Credentials
slides.body: Indonesian Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka submitted his resignation after a Supreme Court ruling invalidated a high-school document from his 2024 campaign. The sudden departure threatens to destabilize President Prabowo Subianto's ruling coalition.

slides.scene: A wooden podium in a marble government hall under bright press lights, flanked by American flags.
slides.headline: US House Blocks Impeachment Bid Against Defense Chief
slides.body: House Republicans blocked an impeachment resolution targeting Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over accusations of unauthorized military actions against Iran. President Trump praised the vote, halting the effort before reaching a full House floor vote.

slides.scene: A clinical medical ward at sunset, with a silhouette of a patient stepping out into bright daylight.
slides.headline: Kenya Discharges Last Ebola Patient in Major Milestone
slides.body: Kenya discharged its final Ebola patient, per the BBC, marking a crucial step toward virus-free status. The country has initiated a mandatory 42-day countdown before health authorities can officially declare the outbreak ended.

slides.scene: A high-angle view of Old Trafford stadium illuminated at night under light rain.
slides.headline: Manchester United Advance Talks to Appoint Mauricio Pochettino
slides.body: Manchester United are progressing in negotiations to hire former Tottenham and Chelsea manager Mauricio Pochettino as their new head coach. Reports indicate he has emerged as the leading candidate for the vacant role.
